description: This file implements the CallService class for a modem simulator, handling various telephony commands such as dialing, answering, rejecting calls, managing call states, and emergency modes within a virtualized environment.

classes.name: CallService
classes.description: A class that simulates telephony call management, including dialing, answering, rejecting, and managing call states, as well as handling emergency modes in a virtual environment.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the service state, including emergency mode and mute status.

methods.name: SetupDependency
methods.description: Sets up dependencies on other services like SimService and NetworkService.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of command handlers for telephony commands.

methods.name: SimulatePendingCallsAnswered
methods.description: Transitions dialing calls to active state.

methods.name: TimerWaitingRemoteCallResponse
methods.description: Handles timeout for remote call responses, cancels the call if timeout occurs.

methods.name: HandleDial
methods.description: Processes the ATD command to initiate a call, including local and remote calls, emergency calls, and call state updates.

methods.name: SendCallStatusToRemote
methods.description: Sends call status updates to remote endpoints.

methods.name: HandleAcceptCall
methods.description: Handles the AT+ATA command to accept incoming calls.

methods.name: HandleRejectCall
methods.description: Handles the AT+ATH command to reject or hang up calls.

methods.name: HandleCurrentCalls
methods.description: Handles the AT+CLCC command to list current calls.

methods.name: HandleHangup
methods.description: Handles the AT+CHLD command to manage call hangups and transfers.

methods.name: HandleMute
methods.description: Handles the AT+CMUT command to mute or unmute the microphone.

methods.name: HandleSendDtmf
methods.description: Handles the AT+VTS command to send DTMF tones.

methods.name: HandleRemoteCall
methods.description: Handles remote call commands to simulate remote call states.
